turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit properly, bags under the desk. Today we are doing subtraction.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: First sum on the board, fifty two minus twenty seven. Rabi, tell me the answer.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: No Ravi, thirty five is wrong. Answer is twenty five. Everybody say twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjoon, thirty five again? I just told. Don't be careless, listen in class. Next.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: See again. Two minus seven not possible, so take ten, twelve minus seven five, then four minus two two. Twenty five. Two minus seven not possible, take ten. Understood now?
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Thumbs up who understood. Everybody thumbs up? Good.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Next sum. Forty three minus eighteen. Mina, answer.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Twenty six? No no, stop counting on fingers. Answer is twenty five. Write twenty five in your notebook.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Okay, enough for now. Close your notebooks, we will do more tomorrow.
turns.label: other
